method: Seed the committed documentary case in a temporary directory, replay the exact s_proxy version-2 item_put payload from event 31 through the installed organon CLI under signed policy, and compare stable status and trace semantics with the recorded revision check.
historical_snapshot_note: revision_check.json records gate blocker strings immediately after event 31. Current engine wording for human approval differs and the current trace checks add blockers; the regression compares stable readiness, acceptance, staleness and IDs instead of exact historical blocker text.
limits: This is a no-network documentary replay in a temporary case; it does not recapture the June 2026 report or any live GBFS response.
The case is exposed development material, not sealed R-M or an independent mobility assessment.
No station-minute availability, frustrated trips, intervention, causal effect or normative human approval is established.
The CLI gate regression verifies structural reuse of the toolkit, not GOAL criterion 5 generalization.
